text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
On the way back home with Mejiro<n>Dober, we spot
a poster of Mejiro<n>McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Hey look, it's a poster of McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yeah. She ran a great race the<n>other day, but
that's just par for the<n>course for a Mejiro!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I'm fine. I was just thinking how<n>right they are.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I was just thinking, "Yep, that's<n>McQueen for
you."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Even the way she carries herself in<n>day-to-day life
is just different... All<n>while shouldering way more
responsibility than I do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Even the way she carries herself in<n>day-to-day life
is just different... All<n>while shouldering way more
responsibility than I do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
She has this aura of dignity and the<n>skills to back it
up... No one can<n>represent our family like her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Just then, we pass by a bookstore<n>and spot
someone very familiar.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: M-McQueen?! Didn't expect to run<n>into you here...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
D-Dober?! I was, erm... just passing<n>by, you see,
and certainly not here to<n>purchase the special
feature on<n>Yutaka or anything...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yutaka? Wait... that Yutaka?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Wait, Dober... you knowYutaka?!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The mention of Yutaka excites them<n>both, and we
end up ducking into a<n>diner so they can chat.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Uh, yes? Oh, McQueen, did you see<n>the thing from
the other day?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Uh, yes! Oh, McQueen, did you see the<n>thing from
the other day?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, I saw it in real time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, I saw it in real time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you keep up with things in real<n>time? I like to
wait and binge<n>everything at once.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, well, that lets you savor things at<n>your own
pace, I suppose...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
But is it not thrilling to experience<n>things as they are
happening?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hm... I guess, but the location is, well,<n>you know...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Location? Oh, if you mean watching in<n>person, I
suppose it is rather far...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Far? What do you mean? You can<n>buy magazines
anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Magazines? I'm talking about the<n>baseball
stadium...
choice_data_list:
I don't think you two are talking about the same
thing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What? We're talking about Yutaka,the manga artist, aren't we? The onebehind Burn Bright! Shibasaki Girls'Soccer Club.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! I thought we were talking<n>about Yutaka the
baseball player!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Sorry... I just got so excited when I<n>thought we
liked the same thing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Same here... I thought we'd found a<n>common
interest... So there's a<n>manga artist named Yutaka
too, is<n>there?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I imagine their work must be<n>fascinating, given how
passionately<n>you talk about it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. We'll have to chat again<n>sometime soon, and
then you can tell<n>me all about them!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I had no idea McQueen had a fangirlside to her...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Guess so.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Multifaceted... Yeah, I guess so.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to see more... See what other<n>sides there
are to McQueen.
choice_data_list: Why don't you lend her some of your manga?
We could go to a baseball game together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Now I'm curious to see what other<n>sides there are
to McQueen, sides I<n>don't know about...
choice_data_list: Why don't you lend her some of your manga?
We could go to a baseball game together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: No, I don't want to be pushy or<n>anything...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...But don't you think I'll come across<n>as too
pushy?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sure, but still... Well, I guess it<n>couldn't hurt to ask...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...That's true. I'll try asking if she'd<n>like to borrow
some, then.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I see the two of<n>them happily
conversing in the<n>cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I see the two of<n>them happily
conversing in the<n>cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that can't be! We have to wait<n>until the next
volume to find out what<n>happens to the club?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh... Ahem. Apologies for getting<n>carried away.

No, no, it's just... You had the exact<n>same reaction I
did, so I was<n>surprised... and happy.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Yutaka the manga artist,<n>the two of them
become a little closer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's... a good idea. I've been<n>wanting to go to
one, so I think I'll<n>ask her.

A few days later, the three of us are<n>on our way
back from a baseball<n>game...

A few days later, the three of us are<n>on our way
back from a baseball<n>game...

Oh, I still cannot believe how much I<n>screamed
during the game... How<n>mortifying...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Don't be embarrassed! That home<n>run was
scream-worthy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I know, right?! That decisive swing<n>was proof that
he hadn't given up<n>despite how far behind they
were!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The tension right before he swung<n>was palpable... I
can see why you like<n>baseball so much. I'd love to
learn<n>more.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Truly? Then we must attend anothergame sometime!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'd like that!

The two chat enthusiastically about<n>the game the
entire way home.
